dir.description: The directory path to work on. Defaults to current directory.

comment_file.description: Specify the file where you want to save/load doc comments.

ignored_files.description: List of filenames to ignore when stripping files. Can be repeated.

ignore_macros.description: Ignore macros in hierarchy so only macros with doc comments appear.

ignore_doc_commented.description: When regenerating, stored doc comment won't be regenerated if already present.

no_file_output.description: Display doc comments directly on stdout instead of saving to a file.

mode.description: Operation mode: 'strip' to create doc comments file, 'regenerate' to recreate files from doc comments file.
